storyInfo: Tsar Fyodor ends up trapped in Katorga with the students by a strange twist of fate. Through comms, he establishes contact with Botani, who is also in Katorga, and encourages her to take a key hostage, bringing him back to the student camp.

attributes.content: ...What are you doing, Mykola?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Someone was falling behind—
attributes.name: Ursine Student A

attributes.content: So you decided to break formation on the left flank? Do it over!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Good. Advance with your spears and force me into a corner.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You're too strong, Sonya. We can't budge you.
attributes.name: Ursine Student B

attributes.content: It's not that I'm too strong, it's that you are not pushing together.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You have to remember, we're not guerillas. The empire will not protect us, so we must form a fortress together.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Do you understand?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Yes, ma'am!
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: Hey, General! Still training?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: You just got back?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: What's the sitch?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Good news, the cannons and heavy weapons they were showing off yesterday are gone.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Nika saw the thugs moving a bunch of stuff out. Looked like weapons.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Natalya got it done, Sonya.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: ...I knew we could count on them.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Also, like we were talking about, Gromov sleeps in a camp inside the quarantine zone each night. Only Pavlovich lives on top of the walls.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We can smash the thugs' main force before we assault the wall.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We need more food and other supplies. Did you see their warehouse?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: No... How much longer can we stretch these rations?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Three days, max. The Unbound are running short also. We owe Antosha too much already.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I got a bad history with food supplies... I can't—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Hold my hand! It'll be okay, General. We'll get through this.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We need to keep training. I got a feeling the next few days are gonna decide our fate.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Just how many are willing to fight...?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Surprisingly many. They've seen our training these last few days pay off. And the rest are willing to do first aid and logistics.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: There's nothing young people hate more than injustice, is there?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You've done a good job, that's all.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: What about that Fedya? He's not a student. Is he willing to join?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Hm... I'm still not sure if we can trust him.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We really don't know anything about him. But he is determined.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Fedya! I found a can of meat. Want some?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: ...No, thank you.
attributes.name: Fedya

attributes.content: Don't push it. You haven't known him that long, you don't know he likes to be alone.
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Come on, it's been a few days, we're not exactly strangers anymore.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Say, Fedya, you don't look like a student, but you don't look like a worker either.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: How did you ever end up in this hellhole?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: ...I'm sorry, but I can't divulge that, under any circumstances.
attributes.name: Fedya

attributes.content: Whuh?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Just who the hell...?
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: <p=1>December 24th, 1101</><p=2>30 minutes before the Winter Ball</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Time is short, Your Imperial Majesty. I beg you to consider it one last time.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Consider, yes—I'm considering feeding all these obese geriatrics to flesh buthidas.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: That way, we'd get a windfall for the treasury by confiscating their assets, and a bunch of well-fed, succulent flesh buthidas.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Majesty... I completely understand your fury.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: But you must understand that these old nobles are more willing to stand with you than the industrial nobles, who put clear price tags on their loyalty.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You need as many voices on your side as you can at a time like this, when you need to impress the Armies that continue to encroach upon the far shores of Lake Neva.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: And that's their leverage to bargain with me?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Even my palace can barely afford heating this winter, and they want me to give them Originium to supply that unproductive Katorga Raion?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Is it those morsels of profit that they're after? No! They simply seek to emphasize their presence to me and make me bow to them. They will not get their wish!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The Grand Duchess of Far North, the Armies, and these old nobles...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: When did we allow these leeches to our empire? They suck the blood of Ursus, and all it takes is the slightest opportunity for them to proclaim our weakness and claim Grypherburg for themselves!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Tell me, Witte... tell me that we can still demand their respect, that my assent to their ridiculous demands will not be seen as weakness.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Tell me you can make those old aristocrats go to war, risk life and limb in battle, and chase the Fourth Army back to where they belong—otherwise, do NOT trouble me with this matter again!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You know, Witte, sometimes, I can't help but think that there is too much rot growing on Ursus, like that Katorga they're so obsessed with protecting, and those people themselves.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Majesty is certainly correct. The Empire of Ursus is sick. But any doctor can tell you that one must be careful about what medicine to give the very ill.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Our Originium reserves are on the brink. You must do everything in your power to stop the forces of sedition from growing within Ursus, until we can come up with a material solution.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Otherwise, our internal conflicts will destroy us before any external foe or force of nature.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Fantastic. Great Ursus is as fragile as a Gaulish omelette, falling apart at the slightest touch.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You need not do much.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Simply placate them as usual, tell them that Ursus needs their loyalty, and that you intend to protect their interests.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I will handle the rest.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Do whatever you want, Witte.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm used to it. Those bemedaled skeletons and perfumed parasites stand in the way of everything I try to do... they don't care about Ursus, and they certainly don't care about me.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You can explain it to them when you attend tonight's ball.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Can't you and the Vice Chairman go for me? I'm tired.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It would be improper, Majesty.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You cannot refuse to attend the Winter Ball two years in a row. At a time like this, when people's hearts are unsettled, your subjects look to you to offer some degree of comfort—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Alright, alright, I'll go, just give me some time, please! That's enough talk. We've had too many vexations this winter already.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Leave me, Witte... please. And, I'm sorry.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Blyat! Blyat! Blyat...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Fyodor looks out the window. The streets of Grypherburg are nowhere near as bright as they were years past.
Such a cold winter... it could really use a fire.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What's this...? A power outage?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Death to the mudak tsar! Death to the mudak tsar! Death to the mudak tsar!
attributes.name: Angry Student

attributes.content: Bring out the bloodsucker Witte! Bring out the imbecile Fyodor!
attributes.name: Angry Student

attributes.content: You're looking for me? Here I am.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: My, what a commotion.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Please! Stop! No more!
attributes.name: Frightened Student

attributes.content: Shut up! How dare you insult His Imperial Majesty! Traitor!
attributes.name: Tall Policeman

attributes.content: He strikes the student's back with such force that his stick flies from his hand, falling by the wayside. Then it is fists and kicks that find their mark...
Enough, enough! He's not resisting. No need to beat him so hard.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Another traitor to the empire!
attributes.name: Tall Policeman

attributes.content: Traitor to the empire? Hah! Whose empire?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Insolent mudak! You need a beating too!
attributes.name: Tall Policeman

attributes.content: Such impudence!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: How dare you hit me!
attributes.name: Tall Policeman

attributes.content: Indeed, I hit you. You may boast to your children that the tsar—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: A heavy fist finds Fyodor's face before he can finish.
*Bzz*... target... escape... capture, complete! Over!
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: In the name of... *bzz*... His Imperial Majesty! Over!
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: The concealed communications device that Fyodor carries has fallen on the ground by the time he gets up. With no time to examine it, he quickly grabs it and puts it back in his ear.
...Blyat.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Mayday! Mayday! Anyone hear me?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: All Student Assembly members, evacuate immediately! The lead vehicle is driving towards the outskirts!
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: If you can hear me, answer ASAP! Botani out!
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Wait—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Several policemen grab and push him into the crowd that is being packed up into the cramped trucks.
The trucks drive to Katorga Raion, to the sound of frightened crying.
And so... we were all captured.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: No explanations, no promises, no food, no tents.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: We were tossed into Katorga like garbage.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Don't worry! I'll help you!
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: The diminutive student keeps Fyodor behind him, wildly swinging the tibia of some unidentified beast at the surrounding tuskbeasts.
Stay behind me! I've hunted in the Far North with my father! I can handle these beasts! Trust me!
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: Look out!
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: Phew... they're gone. That was close.
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: He drops to the ground in a pile of snow, panting.
Your arm. It's hurt.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Huh? Argh... you wouldn't happen to have alcohol and bandages on you, would you?
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: No. But I'll find you the finest doctors in Grypherburg once we are free of this place.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Don't worry about it. It's cold here, maybe it won't get infected.
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: What's your name?
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: ...Fyodor.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Let me call you Fedya, since I've helped you. You can call me Shorty. That's what my friends call me.
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: You don't mind?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Minding doesn't change anything... If you're not hurt, I'll go on ahead.
attributes.name: Shorty

attributes.content: Wait, you're going to the wall?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Yes, my friend told me that the one in charge here lets you go if you pay up.
attributes.name: Shorty

attributes.content: I put together some money. Not sure if it's enough, but I figured I might as well take the chance.
attributes.name: Shorty

attributes.content: Here, you can have this ration bar. If you need a place to start a fire, the students have a camp down on the south side.
attributes.name: Shorty

attributes.content: Bye, Fedya—
attributes.name: Shorty

attributes.content: ...Wait.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Take these chervontsy. This should be enough to bribe the guards.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Emotions flash rapidly across Shorty's face. He bows solemnly to Fyodor and walks to the walls.
Please, hear me out—!
attributes.name: Shorty

attributes.content: *Bzz*... this is Botani calling anyone who can hear me. Anyone?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Please, do you copy...?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: The Council of Sixteen thugs are killing students! We need help!
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Can anyone hear me? Come in, please?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Have we been abandoned? Are our cries and screams soundless?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: It's a wall, not the great tundra! Why...?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: (Sobs) Why doesn't anyone hear us...?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: What should I...?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Botani out.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: (Rasping call) Attempt No. 373. Calling anyone who can hear me...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: We are trapped in Grypherburg's Katorga Raion, unable to contact anyone on the outside...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Yesterday alone, five students died from blunt force trauma and hypothermia... there may have been more. We find ourselves on the brink of death, here in the glorious capital of Ursus.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: The people who murdered my friends now sit in a room above me...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Attempt No. 374. Come in, come in...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: ...Maybe you'll never be like that voice from the Far North, Botani. You'll never change anything.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: How could I make people hear my voice, so that all these lives can be saved?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: (Sound of pained vomiting)
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: (Sobs)
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Three hundred and seventy-four... you have shown more spirit than any bureaucrat in the palaces of Deity Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Maybe you don't realize it, but you are doing great deeds.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Huh?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Y-You can hear me? Who is this...?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: I... I'm Fedya. I'm from Sonya's camp.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Sonya's camp... I know of it, but I couldn't go, no, I didn't dare...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: I sneaked into the last truck that came here... I wanted to tell the people of Grypherburg the truth of what I saw, the cruelty and brutality that's being inflicted upon the young people here.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: But nobody answered, nobody heard me... this room I'm hiding in is right in the middle of the thugs' camp...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: They came in today, and they stabbed the wardrobe that I'm hiding in with a freshly-honed knife... I think I can still hear its blade trembling...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: I can't come out. They'll get me for sure.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: (Sobs) I can't do anything—
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: In that case...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Why do you keep talking?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Why?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: There are thugs all around you. The wise would remain silent and cover their eyes and ears, the wise would ignore everything going on around them...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What is happening in Katorga had nothing to do with you... you could have remained silent. You live in danger and in pain. No one would blame you.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Yet you entered the quarantine zone and risked exposure to publicize the tragedies, even though no one is listening. You believe every call you make offers hope to the students.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I can... offer hope... the students need...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Unless you have a better explanation... I've really had quite enough, listening to a brave soul lament her cowardice. I come out here just once and I seem to keep running into this sort of thing.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: How many hostiles on your end?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Two.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Good. Just the two of them won't catch you. Can you hear their movements from your location? Like what they're saying, what shape they're in?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...I can hear, if I listen carefully. They keep complaining about work and yawning. They seem tired.
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Excellent. The tired are less alert. They are people too; they can grow weak or careless. Even you should be able to kill someone who is badly fatigued.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: That's too—
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Well, it's up to you whether you do it or not. But you can run, can't you?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Tonight, once they're asleep and you can hear them snoring, run, and don't look back.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If you don't know the way, I'll guide you. I walked all the way from the wall to the camp. I remember the buildings you'll pass.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If you try, you'll find that it's not so hard after all.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Will I continue to hear your voice?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: If it gives you the courage to move...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: She recalls the day she decided what she wanted to do with her life.
The smell of dust and dirt, and overheated electronics... she curled up on a chair, searching for news of Bresk—of home, amidst the haphazard and scattered frequencies.
'Next, an excerpt from the opera—'
'Hiss—'
She fiddles with the knob. She needs to hear the sound of hope, a power that brings comfort, to keep the weightless panic in her chess, even for just a moment...
—What?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: 'Bzz, bzzt...'
'Comrades in the mines and cities.'
'We come from the Far North.'
...I'll try.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Can I ask who you are? You're not a student, are you?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: ...That is correct, but Sonya permits my presence.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I see... I've been providing communications support for the Student Assembly. Any student who hears my voice recognizes me and the code name 'Botani'.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Take a break, Pavalo. Even I'm tired after hauling all those crates today, you must be exhausted.
attributes.name: Voice From Upstairs

attributes.content: It-It's an honor to carry Master Gromov's burdens.
attributes.name: Pavalo's Voice

attributes.content: Come on, you got a barony from your dad, you could grovel a little bit less.
attributes.name: Voice From Upstairs

attributes.content: He's long gone, and our family is...
attributes.name: Pavalo's Voice

attributes.content: Can you tell Gromov, I just want to leave, you guys kidnapped me—
attributes.name: Pavalo's Voice

attributes.content: Shut it. Yeah, I kidnapped you, big deal. Boss needed someone who was good with numbers. It's not like you've been treated badly.
attributes.name: Voice From Upstairs

attributes.content: You want to get out, talk less and work harder.
attributes.name: Voice From Upstairs

attributes.content: What is it, Botani?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: No, it's nothing.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: It's just that when I get a chance to actually listen to them talk... they don't seem so scary anymore.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Hmph. I know exactly how many good-for-nothings there are in Ursus.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Hehe...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Thank you, Fedya.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Thank you for hearing my voice.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: A cold draft keeps blowing in from the window that will not shut, causing the rickety house to hum quietly in the night.
Sitting in front of a dirty table, Pavalo flips through the ledger to the deafening snores of his colleague in the next room, his brow furrowed.
How come I haven't seen a shadow of any of the supplies that Gromov requested...?
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: No, the purchase price is much higher than the market price, and the Sixteen Warriors' nominal wages are far higher than what they actually are.
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Hmph. A tale as old as Grypherburg itself.
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: He sneers. At almost the same moment, the roaring snore is interrupted, replaced by a wet, bubbling sound, as though someone is gargling.
Dreaming about meat again? Mudak sounds like he fell into a soup pot.
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: The gurgling ceases, replaced by the sound of liquid dripping on the floor.
...A leak?
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: He rubs his dry eyes and gets up to head over to the next room.
Pavalo opens the door. His pupils contract in shock, and he drops the ledger to the floor. Deep crimson liquid is seeping from his colleague's neck.
Ahh—
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Hush... your life is in my hands, Baron.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Wh-Who are you?
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Th-That's not important. What's important is that I need your help.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: ...Your voice is trembling, and your hand's trembling even worse. Are you nervous?
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Put down the knife, devushka, and we can talk about this—
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: No...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: I-If you shout, or try to stall for time, I'll have to kill you.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Like you said, my hand's trembling. I can't promise you it won't accidentally slip...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: P-Please, I have a family back home. Spare me, and I'll do anything—
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: ...Put on this headset.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: What...?
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: I won't keep holding you up with a knife, but if you make one wrong move... this headset represents the latest research from the Third Bureau. It can blow your head off your shoulders at any time.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: The Third Bureau?! N-No, how did I get on their bad side—
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Quiet... someone will tell you where to go through the headset. You will lead me there, avoiding all Sixteen Warriors positions along the way. Do you understand?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Y-Yes...
attributes.name: Pavalo

attributes.content: Tell me where your camp is, I'll head there...
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: Ha, haha—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...What's so funny?
attributes.name: Voice in Earpiece

attributes.content: No, it's nothing. First, tell me the buildings you see around your position—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm getting my very own 'mission'... this is certainly unexpected, but not entirely unwelcome.
Let me think... how do those Third Bureau freaks talk?
